title: Publish deferred idle Stop deltas when a repeat confirms the pause
outcome: When the background writer accepts an idle Stop but its own-row fence initially rejects confirmation, a successful repeated Stop delivers the deferred test-run wait consumption and stopped-message updates to clients without creating a second message.
acceptance: A repeated successful Stop after an unconfirmed background idle Stop delivers the original consumed-wait and stopped-message updates without a duplicate transcript entry.
A behavior test drives the background row-confirmation failure and repeat through the Stop route and observes the client updates.
